Decisions that belong to counsel, not to this console. HIPAA classification and business-associate agreements; what a Brazilian physician may review while the client is in a given US state; the exact health-information consent instrument; cross-border transfer terms; cancellation amounts and deadlines; travel-insurance minimums; the seven-day arrival rule; referral compensation; arbitration and liability; and every savings or provider-quality claim.
ConcernsEvery one has a case number and an audit trail

How the team handles reviews. Never threaten legal action because a review is negative. Never offer anything conditional on a positive review, and never ask a client to hand over ownership of one. Suspected fake reviews, impersonation, privacy violations or threats are documented here and reported to the platform. A client’s medical photographs and health information never enter a review or testimonial workflow, and any use of an identifiable photograph, video, testimonial, voice or likeness needs its own signed media authorization. Counsel approves any correction or removal template before the team uses it.
